bringup: Verify every adapter footprint and header mapping with a meter before installing MOSFETs; inspect SMD joints under magnification.
Check the carrier graph unpowered. Initially substitute a current-limited bench supply at SYS/GND carrier inputs with charger/cell disconnected; keep LEDs disconnected.
Disconnect battery and charger USB, then remove JSV before any ESP USB programming. Confirm 5V/3V3, cold-start latch and active-LOW button; reconnect shunt only after unplugging ESP USB.
Test 12 V branch independently, then individual and combined LED loads. Scope rails and low-end PWM; measure current and temperatures.

Use a battery simulator capable of sinking current for charger tests. Fully switch off before charger USB; no button presses while charging. Open-case supervised charging only at monitored 15–30°C pack temperature until actual current, cell limits and thermal behavior are qualified.

Preserve battery factory protection/wires; replace its connector only as authorized, one conductor at a time. Insulate the completed contact before cutting the other; verify polarity and use recessed battery contacts.
No physical performance, calibration, enclosed charging, current capacity or production qualification is asserted by these drawings.

low_battery_cutoff.method: Hardware open-drain supervisor clamps QH base; no ADC

battery.source: User-supplied listing image; not a manufacturer qualification report
battery.connector: User-authorized XH-style 2-pin replacement; preserve factory wires, protection and pouch
battery.current_rating_status: Listing 1C implies 3 A nominal cell claim only; wire/contact/protection limits remain unverified

external_connectors.label: Battery plug · 2 pins
notes: White XH-style connector from the user’s kit, advertised as XH 2.54 mm. Genuine JST XH is 2.5 mm pitch. Housing geometry is illustrative; actual kit dimensions, mating compatibility and contact rating remain unverified.
Use matched housings, contacts and mating halves from the same kit on properly terminated insulated leads; do not assume different XH-style kits intermate. No carrier mounting holes are assigned.

Project contact numbers: look into the board-side mating opening, latch/key up, count left to right. The opposite mating face is mirrored. Check matching contacts with a meter; do not infer polarity from wire colour alone.
R6 protected pack external positive→CHG.B+; external negative→CHG.B−. System GND is CHG.OUT−; never bridge B− to OUT−. Never bypass the pack protection or expose the raw pouch terminals.

User-authorized replacement of the factory 1.25 mm plug with the existing XH-style two-pin pair: preserve factory leads/protection, cut and complete one conductor at a time, insulate it before cutting the other, use recessed battery-side contacts and meter-check polarity. The factory wire current rating remains unverified.
Mark this BATTERY and keep it physically distinct from BUTTON; never interchange the two identical-looking 2-pin plugs.

Project contact numbers: look into the board-side mating opening, latch/key up, count left to right. The opposite mating face is mirrored. Check matching contacts with a meter; do not infer polarity from wire colour alone.
R6 button joins START to GND when pressed; its dry switch contacts have no polarity. The old OUT+/BTN_N harness is incompatible.
Choose one contact from each side of the switch circuit. Check continuity: open at rest, connected only when pressed.

notes: White XH-style connector from the user’s kit, advertised as XH 2.54 mm. Genuine JST XH is 2.5 mm pitch. Housing geometry is illustrative; actual kit dimensions, mating compatibility and contact rating remain unverified.

One six-pin LED plug carries +12 V, G, R, B, WW, CW in that project contact order. No GND wire belongs in this plug.

Use one common +12 V wire from REG12.VOUT (R6) or boost VOUT+ (historical) through contact 1 to the strip. No split-positive splice. This contact carries the sum of all five channel currents; verify its rating against measured load.
